CalculatedFields.Name: Answer Success Rate %
CalculatedFields.Expression:
/*
Percentage of chat answers with Successful outcome across all rated answers.
*/
ifelse(sum({Successful Answers}) + sum({Failed Answers}) = 0, NULL, sum({Successful Answers}) / (sum({Successful Answers}) + sum({Failed Answers})) * 100)

CalculatedFields.Name: Not Useful Rate %
CalculatedFields.Expression:
/*
Percentage of rated answers marked as Not Useful by users.
*/
ifelse(sum({Rated Answers}) = 0, NULL, sum({Rated Not Useful}) / sum({Rated Answers}) * 100)

CalculatedFields.Name: Usefulness Rate %
CalculatedFields.Expression:
/*
Percentage of rated answers marked as Useful by users.
*/
ifelse(sum({Rated Answers}) = 0, NULL, sum({Rated Useful}) / sum({Rated Answers}) * 100)
